::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Tracked separately from the main `nexchip-hefei` entry (which covers existing operational capacity) because this fourth phase is a distinct, large, separately-financed expansion — ¥35.5 billion for a new 55,000 wafer/month line — launched in January 2026.
:::

**Chinese name:** 晶合集成四期 (Jīnghé Jíchéng Sìqī)

## What does this facility make?

Additional 12-inch (300mm) wafer foundry capacity once complete.

## Why does it matter?

Full capacity is targeted for end of 2028, a multi-year construction horizon typical of the current wave of China fab expansions — a reminder that 'under construction' projects in this sector often run 2-3 years from groundbreaking to full ramp, not months.
